title: Directors Appointment or Resignation
intro: We manage the complete process for appointing or resigning directors, ensuring all legal filings are accurately completed and compliant with regulations.
includes: A letter of Appointment or Resignation for signing
Board resolution accepting the appointment or resignation
Notifying Company House with the update
Digital copy of the updated file
body: For clients who wish to add or remove directors, our team of professionals provides services that includes the filing of Companies House papers and all other paperwork required to keep your business records current and compliant.To guarantee that your new director is appointed properly, our experts will gather the necessary documentation and complete the director appointment paperwork on your behalf. All we need is directors signature.
**For Appointment : **We ask for a letter of appointment from the new director who wants to be added in the company stating that he accepts to be appointed to the board of directors.
**For Resignation : **We ask for a letter of resignation from the existing director of a company stating that he would like to resign as a director.

**Minutes : **Companies are bound by the Companies Act 2006 s. 248 to maintain proceedings of all board meetings and make them available for investigation by any director. The director(s) must approve protocols for the appointment or removal of the director(s).
AP01 – Notifies an appointment of director in a company to the Company House.
TM01- Notifies the termination of a company director to the Company House.

list.title: How it works?
items: Choose the buy now option from our offered packages, complete the order form, checkout, and pay
Our expert team of professionals will prepare all the papers and electronically file appointment or resignation documents to the Companies House.
We will send you an email with an update from the Companies House within 2-3 working days along with your documents digital copy & vat invoice.
